response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, including C++ (albeit limited to early career roles), but lacks recent, deep C++ expertise in industrial automation or on-premises/cloud platform solutions. Security expertise (IEC 62443) is not demonstrated, and cloud platform experience is primarily with AWS CDK and Node.js. The resume shows strong problem-solving and agile collaboration but does not align well with the core technical competencies of the role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems
Strong problem-solving and software craftsmanship skills (TDD, CI/CD, refactoring)
Proven ability to deliver scalable and maintainable solutions in diverse domains
concerns: Limited recent and deep C++ experience in industrial automation or large-scale systems
No demonstrated expertise in IEC 62443 or industrial cybersecurity standards
Cloud experience is primarily in AWS CDK and Node.js, not Azure or C++ cloud solutions
